patch.summary: Zyte cost guide: researched plan structure, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Zyte pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Zyte cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Zyte against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (CI/CD and automation, proxy / web data network) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Formerly Scrapinghub — same vendor; do not treat as two products. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
